title: Membrane-bounded cells that swim and divide, from noise
route: An Allen-Cahn cell with a link ring (phase_membrane) plus a self-repellent trail (kstrail) or a Frey-type mobility switch; see Q:membrane-swimmer-divider.

title: Containment that daughters inherit through division
route: A gated wall (min or harmonic face mobility) that holds a fast species through pinching: xcell-a's gate or ad7's shell on a dividing cell.

title: Heredity with selection driven only by intrinsic deaths
route: membrane_evo with the imposed death disks replaced by whole-body deaths from an extensive maintenance cost; see Q:autonomous-l7-identity-deaths. Claims must name this challenge.

title: Reproducing organized cells that a Laplacian-only twin cannot match
route: Run the owed matched Laplacian twins (Q:owed-laplacian-twins, Q:bd-ad7-gate-vs-lowered-d) on a dividing organized cell.

title: Organized dividing cells that live on a consumed, regrowing resource (not by construction)
route: Lenia with a conserved nutrient gated by the shell (Q:lenia-closed-nutrient-gated-shell), or r-two56 on food (Q:rtwo56-food-limited-cells), with a fork test.

title: Self-propelled organized individuals that repair
route: Damage a mature swimming cell (kstrail crescent with a wall, or an Allen-Cahn swimmer) with an undamaged twin.

title: Interacting populations that reproduce and eat
route: evopursuit prey-predator with fission and a food ledger; see Q:evopursuit-closed-ledger-l7.

title: New kinds keep appearing and replacing old ones
route: Requires autonomous heredity first; then long runs with a novelty measure that does not saturate.
